# overlay

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/overlay"
```

Package overlay is the stack of modals floating over the panes. The top one gets every key; Esc pops it unless it says it owns Esc; the rest of the app sees nothing while the stack is non\-empty.

## Constants

<a name="MaxInner"></a>MaxInner stops a modal spanning a wide terminal: past this a line stops being scannable anyway.

```go
const MaxInner = 120
```

<a name="Box"></a>
## func [Box](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/overlay/box.go#L22>)

```go
func Box(lines []string, body layout.Rect, style lipgloss.Style) string
```

Box frames lines in style and clips them to body, so an overflowing modal never pushes its own border off screen. Lines cut are counted on the last row.

<a name="BoxWidth"></a>
## func [BoxWidth](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/overlay/box.go#L28>)

```go
func BoxWidth(lines []string, body layout.Rect, inner int, style lipgloss.Style) string
```

BoxWidth is Box with the content width chosen by the caller, for a form that reads better narrower than the terminal allows.

```

```

<a name="FilePicker"></a>
## type [FilePicker](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/overlay/filepicker.go#L24-L32>)

FilePicker is the bubbles file picker in a modal. Enter picks a file and closes, running onPick; enter or → opens a directory, ← or backspace goes up, and from a drive's root lists the drives. esc is the stack's. Push it with Open.

```go
type FilePicker struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewFilePicker"></a>
### func [NewFilePicker](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/overlay/filepicker.go#L58>)

```go
func NewFilePicker(title, dir string, onPick func(path string) tea.Cmd, th theme.Resolved) FilePicker
```

NewFilePicker browses dir, files only, without hidden entries or permissions. onPick, which may be nil, gets the absolute path.
